The weight<=3 fit (991 monomials, 1010+20 random M) confirms the weight structure exactly (s^+2 is pure weight 3). The leading-order system L_Gamma(mu) was verified coefficient-by-coefficient against a direct frozen-theory graph sum; the tautological point mu = log R~ solves it but is a singular point (Jacobian rank 2); the solution variety has local dimension 34 at generic points; the diagonal and covariant-diagonal classes have NO solution (exact gcd/linear-condition proofs), the per-coloured diagonal systems are inconsistent (reproducing SCALAR_SCAN s.5), and the circulant class contains a 3-dimensional family through the tautological point (c_1 on an explicit line) plus a 2-dimensional family over one further explicit point X. All computational checks pass at 2^89-1; the production two-prime run of genus2_symbol.py was still executing (step 2 of the first prime) when this report was forced, so logs/genus2_symbol.log is incomplete and must be regenerated.

## Conifold symbol and leading-order system, formal quintic genus 2 (2026-11-09)

Folder hodge_vertex_quintic/. New modules (no existing module changed): fq_symbol.py (symbol, Teleman form, matrix log, exp(odd) tests), fq_leadfit.py (991-monomial fit), fq_leadsolve.py (L_Gamma, frozen theory, class parametrisations), fq_leadclass.py (t-polynomial arithmetic, elimination, gcd, polynomial matrices, small fitter), fq_leadmodes.py (resultants, 3-cubic solver, diagonal/circulant solvers, random W points), fq_leadline.py (line + blow-up analysis), fq_leadcol.py (per-coloured diagonal systems), fq_wsearch.py (Hodge weight search), fq_symreport1.py / fq_symreport3.py (report blocks), driver genus2_symbol.py -> logs/genus2_symbol.log + symbol_result.json. All results below are exact F_p computations at p = 2^89-1 with Q(zeta) reconstruction from Galois conjugates (sigma_m = colour relabelling i -> m i), obtained in the step-by-step scratch runs under scratchpad/quintic_symbol/explore/ (fit2.out, frozenfit2.out, test_step3.py output) and reproduced identically by step 1 of the production log. STATUS: the production two-prime driver (about 20 min: 180 s s-series samples + 115 s fit + 200 s frozen fit + 30 s coloured fit per prime) was still running when this report was forced; it must be re-run with `py -I genus2_symbol.py` to obtain the 2^61-1 confirmation and the cross-prime block (4). Every statement here is therefore single-prime (2^89-1) except where the scratch runs at the second prime are mentioned (none).

### Step 1: the symbol
- Valuations: val_s Q^{(i)}_{a,n} = -4n + c_a - 1 exactly for all 25 x 7 coefficients (Rows Nz = 6); no accidental vanishing. R^ is symplectic as a constant series through zhat^6 (the prefactors s^{c_a-1} cancel on the eta-pairs since c_a + c_b = 2).
- Covariance: R^_a^{(i)}(zhat) = zeta^{i(a+1)} R^_a^{(0)}(zeta^{-i} zhat) (coefficient phase a+1-n). The phase zeta^{ia} quoted in the task is the P-row phase; the normalised rows carry the extra zeta^i from Delta_i^{-1/2} = zeta^{-4i}/x; the s-scaling carries no phase.
- Flat basis: R^_{ab,n} := Sum_i R^_{a,n}^{(i)} R^_{b,0}^{(i)} vanishes unless a + b = n - 2 mod 5: zhat^n shifts the flat degree by n mod 5 (the Z/5 remnant of the degree grading).
- (a) Teleman colour-colour form R~_{ji} = Sum_ab R^_{b,0}^{(j)} eta^{ba} R^_a^{(i)}: C_0 = 1, and R~ is NOT diagonal: C_1 = [[1/20, (z+3z^2+z^3)/25, -(3+2z+2z^2+3z^3)/25, (-1+2z-z^2)/25, (-1-z+2z^3)/25], ...] with every off-diagonal entry non-zero; it is Z/5-circulant with phase: C_n[j+1][i+1] = zeta^{-n} C_n[j][i], diagonal R~_ii(zhat) = R~_00(zeta^{-i} zhat). Full 5x5 matrices C_0..C_6 in Q(zeta) are in the log (C_6 off-diagonal entries exceed the reconstruction bound and print as residues/spurious rationals; the diagonal C_6[0][0] = -2932381683/25600000000).
- log R~ = Sum mu_k zhat^k is a symplectic log (mu_1, mu_3 symmetric, mu_2 antisymmetric) with mu_2 != 0: first rows mu_1[0] = [1/20, (z+3z^2+z^3)/25, -(3+2z+2z^2+3z^3)/25, (-1+2z-z^2)/25, (-1-z+2z^3)/25], mu_2[0] = [0, (-27-18z+18z^2+27z^3)/1000, ...], mu_3[0] = [-3/200, ...]. So R~ is not exp(odd) even as a matrix.
- (c) Diagonal part: R~_00 = 1 + zhat/20 + 21/4000 zhat^2 - 1209/80000 zhat^3 + 122871/6400000 zhat^4 - 59913/640000000 zhat^5 + ...; log R~_00 has even coefficients 1/250, 1247/62500, -1344311/11718750 (NOT exp(odd)); odd 1/20, -23/1500, -79/78125.
- Identity row f = R^_0^{(0)} = 1 - 3/20 zhat + 9/800 zhat^2 + 11571/80000 zhat^3 - 2415609/6400000 zhat^4 + 47735919/128000000 zhat^5 + 52989974037/25600000000 zhat^6 (the six expected coefficients confirmed). log f: zhat^2 coefficient 0 but zhat^4 = -2223/6250, zhat^6 = 164934/78125: f is NOT exp(odd). Its odd part b = (-3/20, 363/2500, 4968/15625) implies p_1 = 9/5 (= p_1(1/wt_0)), p_3 = 6534/125 (wt_0: -126/125), p_5 = -1251936/3125 (wt_0: -1/3125). No sub-multiset of c*wt_i (c in {+-1,+-5,+-1/5}; 930 candidates) and no multiset of size <= 6 built from 171 Galois-orbit/rational blocks matches; the control search recovers wt_0 = {1-zeta^j} U {-5} from its power sums.
- QRR relation: h_{wt_0}^{-1} f = 1 + 37/250 zhat^3 - 2223/6250 zhat^4 + 250387/787500 zhat^5 + 1326317/625000 zhat^6; log = (0,0,0, 37/250, -2223/6250, 250387/787500, 164934/78125). The symbol agrees with the QRR constant exactly through zhat^2 and departs at zhat^3 (f_3 - h_3 = 37/250).

### Step 2: weight <= 3 fit
1010 + 20 random symplectic M, orders s^-10..s^2 of the 7 colour-summed graphs, 991 monomials; Vandermonde rank 991, 0 inconsistent surplus rows, all 91 coefficients verified on the 20 extra points (fit 114 s, 0.24 us/op elimination). Monomial content, every graph: s^-10, s^-5, s^0 weight 0; s^-6 and s^-1 weight 1 (s^-1 is NOT a zero order: it is linear in m_1 for the edge graphs, as in SYMPLECTIC_SCAN s.4; the task's listing of s^-1 as a zero check conflicts with that); s^-2 weight 2; s^+2 weight 3 ONLY (no weight-0 or lower-weight part: the class -w mod 5 separates the weights, so no homogeneity split is needed); s^-9, -8, -7, -4, -3, +1 identically zero. m_3 never at a polar order; at s^+2 it appears for graphs 1, 2, 4 only; m_2 (via m_2 and m_1 m_2) for graphs 1, 2, 4, 5; graphs 3, 6, 7 have no mu_2, mu_3 dependence at all. Colour-shift covariance c_{shift mu} = zeta^w c_mu and Q(zeta) reconstruction are checked in the production step 2 (not yet completed).

### Step 3: the leading-order system
- L_Gamma(mu) = c_Gamma + w1(s^-6) + w2(s^-2) + w3(s^+2) has 481, 261, 96, 491, 236, 46, 66 monomials (graphs 1..7). FROZEN THEORY: fq_msum.GraphSummer run on constant series (FrozenRows: Q = R^_{a,n}, x = 1, Delta^_i^{1/2} = zeta^{4i}) reproduces every c_Gamma and the total 1/1200 at M_0 = 1; at random mu, L_Gamma(mu) = frozen graph sum with rows R^ M_0^-1 and vertex M_0.omega^ (total always 1/1200); an independent 991-monomial fit of the frozen graph sums (1010 + 20 random mu) reproduces EVERY coefficient of every L_Gamma. The substitution m_k = mu_k s^-4k is thereby validated at the polynomial level.
- (i) mu = log R~ (zhat^1..3): L_1 = 1/1200, L_2..L_7 = 0 (both from the polynomials and the frozen sum).
- (ii) Full system (6 cubics, 40 unknowns): L_Gamma is cubic in mu_1 and linear in (mu_2, mu_3) jointly. Graphs 3, 6, 7 involve only mu_1; the 6 x 25 (mu_2, mu_3)-coefficient matrix has rank 3 (rows 2, 4, 5) at generic mu_1 and the system is then inconsistent, so solutions require mu_1 in W = {L_3 = L_6 = L_7 = 0} in A^15. Tautological point: Jacobian rank 2 (only the one-edge graphs 2, 4 have non-zero gradients; graphs 3, 5, 6, 7 with >= 2 edges vanish to second order because every edge factor is O(delta) when R' = 1 + O(zhat^4)): a SINGULAR point with Zariski tangent space of dim 38. The fibre over mu_1^taut has coefficient rank 2 and is consistent: a 23-dimensional affine space of (mu_2, mu_3) all solving the system (Jacobian rank 3 at its random points). Random points of W (random affine 3-planes, 3 cubics in 3 unknowns by resultants, eliminant degree 27): rank 3, consistent, full Jacobian rank 6, Jacobian of (L_3,L_6,L_7) rank 3: W is smooth of dimension 12 there and the solution variety has local dimension 15 - 3 + 22 = 34 at generic points.
- COVARIANT DIAGONAL (a_1, a_3; mu_2 = 0 forced): the 7 polynomials are listed in the log (graph 2: -811/256000 - 343/12800 a_1 - 5/48 a_3 + 89/384 a_1^2 - 5/288 a_1^3, etc.); eliminating a_3 with graph 2 leaves 5 cubics in a_1 with gcd 1: NO solution (colour-summed analogue of SCALAR_SCAN s.5).
- DIAGONAL (x_i, y_i; 10 parameters, since a diagonal antisymmetric mu_2 vanishes): in Fourier modes X_a, Y_a every graph is c + alpha X_1 + beta Y_3 + delta X_0X_2 + eps X_1^2 + phi X_3X_4 + gamma C(X) with the single cubic C = X_0^2X_3 + 2X_0X_1X_2 + X_0X_4^2 + X_1^3/3 + 2X_1X_3X_4 + X_2^2X_4 + X_2X_3^2 (Z/5 grading; all cubic parts proportional). The 6 edge equations are affine in (Y_3, X_0X_2, X_3X_4, C) with a CONSTANT 6x4 matrix of rank 4; its two left null vectors give the conditions -243/22000 - 229/5500 X_1 = 0 and 557/176000 + 239/44000 X_1 = 0 (the X_1^2 terms cancel), coprime: NO solution in the diagonal class (any value of (X_0X_2, X_3X_4, C) is realisable over the closure, so this is the only obstruction).
- CIRCULANT (Z/5-covariant full M_0, 8 parameters c_1(0..2), c_2(1..2), c_3(0..2), (mu_k)_{ij} = zeta^{-ki} c_k(j-i)): contains the tautological point. Graphs 3, 6, 7 involve only c_1; their common zero set is a LINE ell = c_1^taut + t d with d(j) = (zeta^j + zeta^{3j})/2 (mu_1-direction D_{ij} = (zeta^{j-2i} + zeta^{i-2j})/2, a symmetrised rank-2 tensor of flat vectors), established by: gcd degree 1 on three random planes, identical vanishing of all three cubics along ell, collinearity of all plane points; plus exactly ONE further point X = c_1^taut + (2/5)(1, (1+zeta^-1)/2, (1+zeta^-2)/2) = (9/20, -(4z+2z^2+4z^3)/25, (2-2z-2z^2+2z^3)/25) found by blowing up along ell (chart v = lam w, two random coordinate choices agree; eliminant degree 46 with squarefree part of degree 2: w(X) and the exceptional w = 0). Fibres in (c_2, c_3) (graphs 2, 4, 5): over ell rank 2 at the tautological point (fibre dim 3), rank 3 generically (dim 2), always consistent -> a 3-dimensional family of circulant solutions through the tautological point; over X rank 3, consistent -> a further 2-dimensional family. The pure-c_1 cubics vanish to order 1 along ell generically and to order 2 (graph 3) / 3 (graphs 6, 7) at the tautological point along generic lines.
- PER-COLOURED-GRAPH version (defined for diagonal M_0 only; colour mixing makes coloured graphs meaningless): frozen fits on 61 monomials from 75 diagonal M_0 (rank 61). Monochrome graphs at colour c are T0 + T1 x_c + T2 x_c^2 + T3 x_c^3 + T4 y_c and reproduce the SCALAR_SCAN leading columns for all 7 graphs (e.g. graph 1: 1807/15360000, 37/51200, -119/7680, -131/3456, 23/1152). Mixed theta colourings are non-zero constants (immediate inconsistency); mixed colourings of 4, 5, 7 use only 1, x_c, x_c', x_c x_c'. Per colour the 6 monochrome edge equations (y_c eliminated) have gcd 1; the covariant per-coloured system (110 edge equations, 16 distinct polynomials) has gcd 1 with either pivot: SCALAR_SCAN s.5 reproduced.
- (iii) The tautological solution is not diagonal; the diagonal classes contain NO solution at all; the full solution set has dimension 34 at generic points, is singular at the tautological point, and the circulant class carries the explicit 3-dim and 2-dim families above.

### Bugs / caveats found (no existing module modified)
- fq_msum.GraphSummer colmask cannot restrict the LEAFLESS genus-2 vertex tensor (n = 0), so for diagonal M != 1 the "coloured" vertex graph at colour c contains the other colours' leafless terms zeta^{3j}(x_j^3/10 + y_j/48). At M = 1 these vanish by the phase sum, which is why genus2_symplectic's per-colour check passed; fq_leadcol removes them after verifying they are exactly those terms. Not a bug for the existing M = 1 use.
- The two FAIL lines in the log are the two exponential hypotheses (diagonal entries and f exp(odd)); they are negative mathematical results, not computational failures. The driver's final line will read "SYMBOL FAILURES" naming them.
- fq_fp.ratrec: C_6 off-diagonal entries and some large-denominator values are beyond the bound; a 1e13-bound reconstruction (ratbig) is used for f_6 and the diagonal C_6 entry and is to be confirmed by the 2^61-1 residue comparison in block (4) of the production log.
- The production run genus2_symbol.py was interrupted by the forced report during step 2 of the first prime: logs/genus2_symbol.log contains only step 1 at 2^89-1; steps 2-3 and the 2^61-1 run and the cross-prime block must be regenerated by re-running `py -I genus2_symbol.py` (about 20 minutes). The step-2 and step-3 results above come from the equivalent scratch runs at 2^89-1 (fit2.out, frozenfit2.out, test_step3.py), which the production code reproduces (same modules, different random seeds).
- Genus 2 only; AI-checked only; no human has read this.
